sections.title: Dispatch
sections.sql: select client,ticket,priority,technician,response_breached,resolution_breached,stale from sla_watch where status <> 'closed' order by priority

sections.title: Projects
sections.sql: select * from project_desk order by due_on

sections.title: Agreement quantities
sections.sql: select client,name,basis,quantity,currency,unit_cents,included_minutes,renewal_due from agreement_desk order by client
sections.note: Quantities are current, not historical. Rates exclude tax.

sections.title: Unbilled time
sections.sql: select client,ticket,description,technician,minutes,approved from unbilled_time order by client

sections.title: Client reviews
sections.sql: select * from client_review order by review_due

sections.title: Privacy record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by client,rule
sections.note: A person assesses harm, exceptions and applicable law. These checks never notify anyone.
